concerns.text: No task creates or validates an artifact that conforms to the `dataset_schema.schema.yaml` contract (raw scRNA‑seq dataset schema). A task should be added to generate or verify a raw dataset file against this schema.

The `metrics.schema.yaml` contract (fidelity metrics per dataset/method) is not referenced by any task. A task should produce an artifact (e.g., `data/metrics/fidelity_metrics.json` or CSV) that validates against this schema.

The `metrics_schema.schema.yaml` contract (embedding metrics) lacks a corresponding task. Add a task that computes and stores embedding‑level metrics (e.g., trustworthiness, local density) in a file validated by this schema.

No task generates an artifact conforming to `model_output_schema.schema.yaml` (individual model term outputs). Introduce a task that extracts model term details from the mixed‑effects/ANOVA fit and writes them in the required schema format.
